messages:
Maya (partnerships): heads up — NovaSys (hw) + AtlasSI want a joint marketplace + SI POC announcement. target week of May 12. thoughts?
Samir (solutions): love it. high level asks from SI: validated hw perf numbers, a quick integration guide for their engineers, and a co-signed case study.
Alicia (product): we need a gated rollout plan: sandbox listing -> private marketplace listing -> public. also pricing SKU + telemetry hooks.
Liam (eng): can we confirm the gateway connector for AtlasSI uses our newest streaming API and supports LangChain runner out of the box? I can spin a test image.
Maya (partnerships): @Liam please make a short runbook for the connector integration. Samir — can you own SI enablement + case study?
Samir (solutions): yes. I'll coordinate a 2-week enablement sprint with AtlasSI. need an example repo + checked-in example prompt set.
Jules (marketing): we'll want embargo dates, joint announcement blog outline, a prerecorded demo, and 2 quotes from customer + partner. do we have a go/no-go checklist?
Maya (partnerships): rough checklist I had in mind: 1) marketplace manifest + screenshots, 2) connector validated on NovaSys hw with perf numbers, 3) security signoff (pen test / SOC2 subset), 4) SI case study draft, 5) joint press copy + embargo, 6) clear support routing + SLAs. anyone add?
Alicia (product): add: telemetry keys exposed to partner for metrics, GUIDELINES for quantization profiles used in perf tests, and a fallback policy defined for capacity constraints.
Liam (eng): adding engine items: a) KV cache warmup script, b) a sample docker-compose to run gateway + runner locally, c) CI smoke test that verifies <100ms cold-start for gen-100 tokens on the target hw.
Samir (solutions): noted. I'll take the case study + SI runbook. Need a template for customer permission and joint logos — @Jules can you share?
Jules (marketing): yes, uploading brand kit and a press template. also propose a 2-week embargo buffer after partner signoff.
DeployBot: created doc: https://docs.redwood.com/internal/partnerships/2045678901-novasys-atlassi-marketplace-plan (permissions: partnerships,marketing,eng)
Maya (partnerships): deployment timeline proposal: week 0 (this week) — integration sprint kickoff. week 1 — perf validation on dev hw + draft case study. week 2 — security review + marketing assets. week 3 — partner signoff + embargo set. week 4 — public announce.
Alicia (product): risk callouts: billing mapping for marketplace SKUs (we need to map usage to NovaSys SKU for any bundled offers), and SSO for SI admins (SCIM / SAML).
Samir (solutions): for the SI POC, AtlasSI wants a preinstalled demo on a NovaSys rack (on prem) and a cloud-hosted variant. who on infra owns the cloud demo?
Liam (eng): infra: @Liam will create a cloud demo snapshot (AMI) and a small infra runbook. I can also coordinate with NovaSys for the rack image.
Jules (marketing): suggested announcement assets: 1) joint blog, 2) product page entry in the marketplace, 3) 2-minute demo vid, 4) one-pager for sales.
Maya (partnerships): embargo date proposal: May 19 public, May 17 partner sigoff. does that work for legal + sec?
Alicia (product): ping legal for partner agreement language re: co-marketing cut. also need security to confirm no PII flows in demo data.
Samir (solutions): ordering checklist for SI-run POC: 1) partner access keys, 2) HW rack reservation, 3) sample dataset (anonymized), 4) test plan (+ pass criteria).
Liam (eng): quick example manifest for marketplace listing (for review):
```
name: novasys-gateway-connector
version: 1.0.0
provider: Redwood Inference
compatibility: [redwood-runtime>=2.3, langchain>=0.2]
artifacts:
  - image: gcr.io/redwood/novasys-connector:1.0.0
  - docs: https://docs.redwood.com/connectors/novasys
pricing:
  sku: novasys-connector-basic
  type: marketplace_one_time
```
please review and flag anything missing.
Jules (marketing): in the blog we should call out the LangChain + LlamaIndex examples we validated; good signal to tooling ecosystem.
Maya (partnerships): next actions: - Liam: draft runbook + manifest by EOD Thu - Samir: SI enablement plan + case study outline by Fri - Jules: assets & brand kit link sent now - Alicia: confirm billing mapping + security gating by next Tue
Samir (solutions): I'll schedule a 30m kickoff with AtlasSI and NovaSys for Thu 10am PT. sending invite.
Liam (eng): starting the perf runs today, will post results to the doc.
Jules (marketing): brand kit link: https://drive.redwood.com/brand/novasys-atlassi-kits
Maya (partnerships): great. if anything slips we push the announce a week. keep updates in the doc thread. thanks all :thumbsup:
